model_asked: gpt-5 concluding, gpt-5-mini collecting for 313; four x gpt-5 for 303
outcome: Two answers that were paid for and never delivered are now in docs/answers, read out of the executions with two GETs. Execution 303: conflicting-evidence, CONTAINER_OOM at confidence 0.35, contradicted_by on two metric points. Execution 313: the same scenario at 0.88. Nothing was re-run to get either.
why_it_matters: Both runs came back HTTP 524 and both executions were status success. The gateway cut the connection; n8n finished. Before the reader existed those answers were unreachable and the money was spent for nothing.
third_data_point: Three confidences now exist for conflicting-evidence on gpt-5: 0.35, 0.75, 0.88. Two of the three are above the declared ceiling of 0.6. That is not a sample, and the thirteenth limitation applies: this model cannot be pinned to temperature 0, so the spread IS part of the answer rather than noise around it.
